svg.title: UML component view: SEC XBRL warehouse
svg.desc: Components of the sec-xbrl-warehouse application, the SEC, filings.xbrl.org (ESEF), EDINET and OpenDART APIs, the operator file inbox (nse, mca, acra) and taxonomy hosts it reads, and the PostgreSQL, MinIO/S3, and ClickHouse stores each component uses.
svg.text: Dashed open arrows are «use» dependencies (client → supplier), labelled with the interaction. Paths are under src/sec_xbrl_warehouse/.

PG = PostgreSQL, S3 = MinIO/S3, CH = ClickHouse. Each source's requests go through its own client (SecHttpClient for the SEC) holding that source's PostgreSQL advisory lock (xbrl:sec-egress, xbrl:esef-egress, xbrl:edinet-egress, xbrl:dart-egress).
Inbox sources (nse, mca, acra) read operator files from local disk: no client, no lock, no network.
